# Foundry provider

The Foundry provider manages resources in the current Microsoft Foundry Agent Service.

## Example usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.11.0"

  required_providers {
    foundry = {
      source = "oWretch/foundry"
    }
  }
}

provider "foundry" {
  account_name = "example"
  project_name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account_name` (String) Foundry account name. Can also be set with `FOUNDRY_ACCOUNT_NAME`.
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Foundry API key. Can also be set with `FOUNDRY_API_KEY`. API key authentication cannot be combined with Microsoft Entra ID authentication.
- `client_certificate_password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the service principal certificate. Can also be set with `ARM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD`.
- `client_certificate_path` (String) Path to a PEM or PKCS#12 service principal certificate. Can also be set with `ARM_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PATH`.
- `client_id` (String) Application or user-assigned managed identity client ID. Can also be set with `ARM_CLIENT_ID`.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Service principal client secret. Can also be set with `ARM_CLIENT_SECRET`.
- `environment` (String) Azure environment. Supported values are `public`, `usgovernment`, and `china`. Defaults to `public` or `FOUNDRY_ENVIRONMENT` when set.
- `oidc_token_file_path` (String) Path to the workload identity token file. Can also be set with `ARM_OIDC_TOKEN_FILE_PATH` or `AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN_FILE`.
- `project_name` (String) Foundry project name. Can also be set with `FOUNDRY_PROJECT_NAME`.
- `tenant_id` (String) Microsoft Entra tenant ID. Can also be set with `ARM_TENANT_ID`.
- `use_cli` (Boolean) Use the signed-in Azure CLI account. Defaults to `true` when no other authentication mode is configured. Can also be set with `ARM_USE_CLI`.
- `use_msi` (Boolean) Use a system-assigned or user-assigned managed identity. Can also be set with `ARM_USE_MSI`.
- `use_oidc` (Boolean) Use workload identity federation. Can also be set with `ARM_USE_OIDC`.
